mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.article_cover, a.article_title, a.type, a.original_url, a.create_time, a.update_time, ca.version AS content_version FROM tb_article a LEFT JOIN tb_content_asset ca ON ca.asset_id = a.content_asset_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.id = #{articleId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.status = 1
SELECT id, user_id, article_cover, article_title, content_asset_id, type, original_url, is_top, is_delete, status, create_time, update_time FROM tb_article WHERE id = #{articleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, article_title, article_cover, create_time FROM tb_article WHERE id != #{articleId} AND is_delete = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, id DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT id, user_id, article_cover, article_title, content_asset_id, type, original_url, is_top, is_delete, status, create_time, update_time FROM tb_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND status = 1 AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
